findings.title: Incomplete comment pagination could authorize duplicate retry

evidence.observation: Structured bounded page argument now reaches comment readback URL.
All full pages traversed before absence; invalid/unavailable/incomplete scan and duplicates deny retry.
Synthetic later-match, failure/truncation/invalid-shape, cap, ambiguity and complete-absence cases exercise fix.

findings.rationale: Source repair removes the reproduced first-page absence-to-POST path. Retained v2 full pagination behavior is restored within explicit fail-closed v3 cap; no live GitHub proof claimed.

V3-F-ac-1.rationale: Assigned native crate, CLI, predecessor constants and read-only projection contracts preserve mapped operational boundaries; complete #179/#180 mapping is covered by the independently assigned evidence lane.

V3-F-ac-2.rationale: Substantive assigned-route review covers typed publication/review, adapter credential/status boundaries, durable transaction recovery, proof/install worktree confinement and fixture limits. Compared retained v2 comment pagination with current v3; R771-ROUTES-1 is now fixed by complete bounded scans and ambiguity rejection, with focused synthetic regression coverage. This is source-semantic parity assessment; parent owns identical-SHA full locked suite and historical live canary evidence remains distinct.

V3-F-ac-3.rationale: Assigned CLI requires typed rollback operation and current guidance requires explicit rollback with suspended authority; shadow/soak execution stays retired. Actual rollback exercise and terminal/cutover implementation are in separately assigned core/evidence lanes.

V3-F-ac-4.rationale: Assigned public guidance and operational dispatch/proof/install require authenticated canonical native authority and exact current context. Missing/stale selector proof does not grant automatic v2 fallback. Typed rollback and cutover delegation preserve approval boundary; no route-level bypass introduced by pagination repair.

path_assessments.csdlc-v3/AGENTS.md: Package instructions preserve native selector authority, typed worktree ownership and adapter outcome boundaries.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/Cargo.lock: Lockfile fixes registry dependencies and checksums for the native crate; no retained v2 path dependency.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml: One library and csdlc binary with explicit serde, markdown, fs2 and blake3 dependencies; native build boundary.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/README.md: Current operational authority is separated from historical construction, rollback requires explicit selector and suspended authority.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/adapters/mod.rs: Completely reread final file: typed page argument reaches per_page=100&page=N URL; page 1..100 only. Credential injection, private config, environment isolation and status/redaction remain unchanged.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/application/mod.rs: Read-only foundation and predecessor projection use explicit repository context, deterministic projections and digest/identity checks.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/commands/mod.rs: Exports local, remote, terminal, proof and sprint route owners without alternate authority selector.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/commands/proof.rs: Proof/install authenticate current worktree, lifecycle generation/digest and canonical authority; retired shadow/soak deny before execution; install checks exact source bytes, destination confinement and output preflight.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/commands/remote/mod.rs: Completely reread final file: canonical authority/current HEAD guards and intent-before-dispatch retained. Comment reconciliation scans full pages to a short page within cap100; every page must have successful nontruncated valid bounded-array output. Incomplete scan, invalid JSON and multiple exact matches cannot enter authenticated-absence retry. Complete absence permits only explicit recovery; one existing match is reused. R771-ROUTES-1 fixed.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/commands/remote/tests.rs: Completely reread final file: existing publication/terminal model, synthetic authority, intent and restart fixtures retained. New negatives cover page2 timeout, truncation, invalid JSON, nonarray, oversized array, duplicate across pages, and cap; positives cover page2 existing match with no POST and complete multi-page absence before one explicit POST. Tests preserve synthetic transport boundary.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/commands/sprint.rs: Sprint readiness reads declared umbrella/child evidence, checks membership denominator and identity, and explicitly emits operational_authority=false.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/lib.rs: Library authority delegates to native canonical authority; retained predecessor and proportional-surface constants are contract denominator, not independent authority.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/lifecycle/mod.rs: Lifecycle transition matrix requires capabilities, invalidates stale projections, separates finish and cleanup, and requires structured review recovery provenance.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/main.rs: CLI dispatch separates operational execute from retained read-only modeling; local diagnostic fallback is restricted to doctor/eligibility topology diagnostics; rollback requires typed rollback operation.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/publication/mod.rs: Publication model binds repository, issue, revision and relation; finish derives closure from matching readback; cleanup checks terminal state, receipt, exact registered canonical path and preview identity.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/repository/mod.rs: Explicit canonical repository context confines record/card reads, rejecting symlink escapes and unsupported card kinds.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/review/mod.rs: Review authorization checks exact scope/revision, actionable findings, principal separation and publication target.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/src/storage/mod.rs: Storage stages typed intent, checks generation/digest CAS, locks durable store and journals before atomic state replacement; failed projection marks repair required and interrupted intent cannot silently resume.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/command_manifest.rs: Command-manifest tests distinguish current native authority from retained pre-cutover denominators and reject obsolete fallback language; help assertions are interface proof only.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/foundation.rs: Foundation tests exercise real and fixture card digests, identity mismatch, unsupported field redaction, symlink confinement and deterministic projections.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/proof_parity_install_comm: Legacy proof/install requests fail missing binding and shadow/soak remain disabled; tests explicitly assert no mutation and structured failure.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/proof_worktree_binding.rs: Local integration uses native binary in a synthetic clone/worktree, validates identity and confinement negatives plus install/proof positives, snapshots mutation surfaces; fixture card construction does not prove binder behavior.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/real_issue_canary.rs: Real issue canary consumes tracked issue records and uses fake remote adapter; modeled readback and generated receipt checks remain local construction proof, not new authenticated live canary.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/remote_publication_comman: Remote publication tests cover receipt durability, exact title/head, closing relation, unexpected closing targets and self-review negatives; synthetic receipts are not live remote evidence.
path_assessments.csdlc-v3/tests/transactions.rs: Transaction tests cover stale writers, persistent intent ordering, failed replacement, projection repair, recovery integrity and adapter secret redaction; fake timeout/cancel cases establish model handling, not real process timeout enforcement.

validation_boundary: Final immutable source review only, no source edits and no live GitHub calls. Parent separately runs full locked suite at this source SHA. Earlier synthetic reproduction demonstrated pre-fix failure; final regression source was inspected without representing synthetic transport as authenticated live proof.
